hook.evidence: 'This drop could outlive you.' — a concrete, surprising stake in five words over a single slow-motion drop; could not open another video.

structure.evidence: Hook -> tomb evidence -> dry -> peroxide -> acid -> 'Dry. Acidic. Self-disinfecting.' -> 'Which is why the only thing that ruins honey… is water.' The 'Add a little water' line sets up the ending; the drop visual loops from open to close; payoff in last 2 lines.

clarity.evidence: Short one-idea sentences ('so honey drinks them dry'); between 3 and 5 because 'Bees add glucose oxidase' drops an unexplained technical term on a cold listener.

pace.evidence: 68 spoken words / 30 s = 2.27 wps — inside 2.0-3.2, just under the 2.3 floor of anchor 5; every sentence one breath and every line has a [VISUAL] cue, so between 3 and 5.

accuracy.evidence: Tomb claim hedged 'reportedly' and '[reported claim; flagged for source check]', water '[source: USDA FoodData]', enzyme '[source: J. Apic. Res. review]'; between 3 and 5 because pH 3.9 is unsourced and 'the only thing that ruins honey… is water' overstates.

voice.evidence: Ownable, specific wording: 'This drop could outlive you.', 'so honey drinks them dry', 'Dry. Acidic. Self-disinfecting.' — no clichés.

notes: Pace counts spoken words only (brackets excluded, punctuation-only tokens excluded) over 30 s target.
